8131.title: CIMD parser ignores advertised public authentication alternatives
8131.rootCauseOneLine: Client metadata admission rejects a non-public singular method without reading the advertised public alternatives.
8131.proposedFix: Review authentication-method selection at the CIMD boundary, validate public alternatives, preserve existing OAuth guards, and test full public code exchange and refresh before deployment.
8131.caveats: Reproduced at the source metadata boundary only. Live ChatGPT metadata, deployed revision, and browser OAuth were not verified. Authentication-policy changes are excluded from autopilot fixes. Related issue #6229 already tracks this mechanism.
